title: Remember Statistics navigation while reopening its tab
status: Source and behavior contract; actual qualification is recorded in the published milestone.
scope: Navigation choices retained only inside one LibraryWindow and the same nonzero profile session.
capture: All choices are captured, including controls in hidden subviews. Only scalar indices, UTC dates and the resolution boolean are retained.

reopen.same_session: A fresh Statistics page is initialized before display. The selected saved view performs its existing lazy read; saved results are not restored.
reopen.already_open: The same open page is reused with its existing state and request behavior.
reopen.lifetime: The old page is destroyed through the existing deferred deletion path. No widget or result packet is retained by navigation memory.
reopen.invalid: An invalid supplied navigation state discards all supplied choices and uses all constructor defaults, including current UTC dates.
reopen.default: Without remembered valid state, Activity / Payload remains first; Transfers uses Current and History uses Daily.
reopen.first_history_read: Only the selected Daily or 7 days view requests its initial date on activation; hidden choices do not create reads.

session.eligible: Only the same current nonzero profile session may restore a closed tab.
session.new_profile: An accepted monotonic profile session clears closed-tab memory before outward callbacks.
session.ignored: Zero, duplicate and older session announcements do not clear valid current closed-tab memory.
session.active_page: Existing navigation and reset behavior of an already visible page is preserved. Closing it later captures its current choices for the new session.
session.excluded: No restoration across different windows or application restarts; session zero never stores closed-tab choices.

safety.requests: Existing page/session/request identity fences and latest-pending coalescing remain unchanged. An old page or late packet cannot settle a new page. Closing a tab does not cancel unrelated work.
safety.library: My Torrents filtering, selection, columns, actions and Ctrl shortcuts remain independent.
safety.hidden: Existing hidden/minimized rendering deferral remains unchanged.
safety.ownership: Trivially copyable value with no pointers, strings, widgets, packets or external resources.

scope_limits.original_runtime_parity: This is a native per-window convenience; no original Java UI persistence or runtime equality is claimed.

qualification: New page and window regression suites exercise actual controls, generated owned profiles, fresh reads, request fences and deletion/reentry. Executed counts and source hashes come from the milestone receipt, not this contract.
